title: The Effect of Patient's Position After Intra-tympanic Injection on the Amount of Fluid in the Middle Ear
brief_summary: During the regular protocol of Intra-tympanic injections of Dexamethasone to the middle ear due to Sudden Sensorineural Hearing Loss, the patients will be sitted once after the injection instead of lying down. They will be then asked to rate their taste as a reference to the amount of fluid leaking to the throat through the eustachian tube.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients diagnosed with Sudden Sensorineural Hearing Loss, treated using intra-tympanic injection of steroids to the middle ear

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with abnormal sense of taste
* Middle or inner ear anomaly
* Eustachian tube dysfunction
